item.description:
Passive app checks keep reading under overlays

  • Background Accessibility checks read the foreground app’s text and links independently of Screen Recording and overlapping windows, matching the working app shortcut.
  • The Dock’s invisible full-display surfaces no longer stop passive reading. Optional local OCR skips covered areas instead of waiting for an entirely uncovered window.
  • Window captures use the display’s pixel scale so screen-text masks align on non-Retina displays and when large captures are resized.
  • Activity shows the latest background-check outcome, separate from manual checks.

Saved monitoring and cloud preferences remain unchanged. Hidden content, recognized input fields and excluded apps remain omitted. Accessibility may read the foreground app’s own text beneath an overlay; passive checks send text only.
